m4.replay_statement: Replayed first, before any Explorer request: the recipes below, taken from the frozen agent history by the fixed replay rule. Each uses one discovery slot and one agent episode and no Explorer request. A source found by one is a history replay of that row, never independent discovery. A replay source goes through the normal loop (reproduction, reduction, diagnosis, candidates) before the next slot; if the campaign's candidate requests (at most 4) are used up there, discovery ends and later replays and Explorer slots do not run.

diagnostics.explanation: Fresh reproduction and the declared controlled intervention support a bounded policy hypothesis.
limitations: A supported hypothesis permits a candidate proposal, never promotion or a claim of improvement.
diagnostics.required_behavior: Preserve original operation identities and require delivered matching receipts for success.
diagnostics.tested_scope: Three fresh trials of the fixed development recipe and declared paired schedule intervention.

m4_run.history_claim_rule: Results of a discovery v4 campaign are history-informed. A source found in a history replay slot is a history replay of that row (discovery_history_replays); any other source whose recipe matches a history row re-tries recorded evidence the Explorer was shown. Report each as such, never as independent discovery, and name the store and the frozen summary hash.
m4_run.replay_claim_rule: A source found in a history replay slot re-ran a recipe from the frozen agent history, chosen by the plan's fixed replay rule and not by the Explorer. Report it as a history replay of that row (name the row, the store and the frozen summary hash), never as independent discovery or as an Explorer pick.
m4_run.terminal_reason: No verified strict improvement within declared development bounds; all outcomes retained
